200.description: The scripts of the player that are still running

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many of the newest lines

info.title: Bot RTS API
info.description: The one API of the game: the web client, third-party clients and the MCP server use it.

bearer.description: The access token of a signed-in session, or an API key (botrts_…) created in the profile. A key is held to its scopes; the scope each route needs is in x-api-key-scope.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code; clients branch on it

status.description: Only an owner may change the status

acceptedPrivacyVersion.description: The version of the privacy policy the player accepted

accessToken.description: The access token; the refresh token travels in an HTTP-only cookie

code.description: A six-digit authenticator code or a recovery code

durationHours.description: Omitted: until an admin lifts the ban

confirmEmail.description: The player's current email, typed to confirm

classLevel.description: Class 1 is the base set every player knows

canResearch.description: The player can research it: the class below it is known

name.description: What `cd` takes; unique among the drives of a bot

path.description: Slash-separated path from the root of the drive

content.description: Only when the file is read, not in listings

userId.description: Only a base has an owner

baseId.description: Any other bot belongs to a base

lastPosition.description: Only a bot whose modules were all taken apart: it has no cell on the map, just its last place

amount.description: What is left of the deposit

userId.description: Set on a point of a player's knowledge

seenAt.description: The game tick the snapshot was taken at

args.description: The arguments of the call, as a script would pass them

code.description: Why the call failed, for example BLOCKED or OUT_OF_RANGE

readyAt.description: When the job is done, in ms

name.description: For a part or a blueprint: the module it is

now.description: The game clock when the status was taken, in ms

parts.description: Finished modules, ready to be assembled into a bot

blueprintItems.description: Blueprints found or looted and not yet learned

module.description: The module whose blueprint to research

itemId.description: A blueprint item held by the base

partIds.description: Module parts held by the base

targetBotId.description: The bot on an adjacent cell whose module is worked on

moduleId.description: The module to repair or take apart

scrap.description: A share of the recipe resources, now in the storage of the bot

blueprint.description: A blueprint item of the module, by chance

seenAt.description: Game time of the snapshot, in ms

capacity.description: What the deposit held when it was generated

isOwn.description: On bots and bases: whether they are the requesting player’s

now.description: Game time of the server, in ms

effective.description: What the player can use: the game and the player switches together

reducedMotion.description: Reduce motion; null follows the system

current.description: The first step not done, while the tutorial is active

family.description: The idea it belongs to; its texts are the translation keys of the family

levels.description: How many levels the family has

threshold.description: What the counter must reach to unlock it

progress.description: Where the counter is now, at most the threshold

unlockedAt.description: When it was unlocked (ms since the epoch)

kind.description: What happened, for example `underAttack`; the translation key of its text

params.description: What the text needs, such as the module or the number of bars

count.description: How many times it happened (repeated events are coalesced)

createdAt.description: When it happened (ms since the epoch); the last time for a coalesced one

unread.description: How many the player has not read, in all

ids.description: The notifications to mark as read; every one when left out

marked.description: How many were marked as read

categories.description: Which categories the player wants to hear about

file.description: The script, as /<drive>/<path> on the drives of the bot

args.description: Arguments of main(bot, ...args): strings, numbers or booleans

engine.description: Present when the node uses the engine

fromHour.description: In-game hour at which this part of the day starts

sunlight.description: How much sun reaches solar panels, from 0 to 1

dayLengthMs.description: One in-game day in real milliseconds; the world clock counts from the Unix epoch

scopes.description: What the key may do; it can only narrow what the player may do

expiresInDays.description: The key stops working after this many days; without it the key does not expire

secret.description: The key itself. It is shown only now; only its hash is stored
